decisions.blocks: Live destination layout and peripheral threat salience (UI-002, UI-008)
decisions.channel: Owner message in the engineering chat session that prepared spec 0.3.4
decisions.decision: The Command Deck Live destination is a second-screen session monitor: an enlarged minimap is the dominant region so movement and approaching threats are visible in peripheral vision, with own-team hero cards (skills and cooldowns when teammates share through the same system) and enemy-team hero cards. Supersedes the inherited top/bottom/right live-field topology.
decisions.safe_interim: Enemy positions and motion only from admitted capture (DATA-005); no predicted paths; unknown stays unknown.
decisions.closure_evidence: UI-002/UI-008 acceptance with frozen-input geometry, reduced-motion and native second-screen evidence.
